name: Tome
tagline: Tome is an AI-native presentation and storytelling tool that generates complete, designed narratives from a prompt, including text, images, charts, and even live data embeds. Rather than a slide deck you assemble piece by piece, Tome treats a presentation as a flowing document, making it well-suited for memos, proposals, and investor updates that benefit from a narrative structure.
